method.scope: Only the four pipeline request stages under this run's cases/001, cases/010, and cases/013. Independent connectivity diagnostics are excluded.
method.logical_calls: One on-disk call.json per actual request. Corrections are distinct calls; accepted-response replay is not a call.
method.tokens: Sum HTTP attempt usage exactly once; top-level transport usage repeats the last attempt and is excluded. Missing usage is unknown, never zero.
method.cache: API-reported cache-hit/miss/reasoning/detail fields are breakdowns, not extra tokens; never add them to total_tokens.
method.prompt_size: Character and UTF-8 byte counts use each actual prompt.txt once per logical request, with a separate content-hash deduplication subtotal. HTTP retries do not create additional prompt records. These are input sizes, not token estimates.
method.time: Call wall, transport call, and HTTP elapsed are alternative/nested measures and must not be added together. Per-case and overall clocks also include local validation and stage work.
method.overall_start: Exact Windows process CreationDate supplied with --online-start for this authorized online process.
method.not_semantics: Usage and completion metrics do not validate sensitivity, demand, or DOE conclusions.

online_timing.basis: online process creation to initial completed pilot summary.json mtime
